_instructions: Approved deployment manifest for Ethereum Mainnet. Replace every placeholder address before deployment: `admin` MUST be the dedicated production Safe (a deployed contract), `managers`/`emergencyLockers` MUST be non-zero, unique, strictly ascending, and 1-10 entries each. DeployVault.s.sol reads this file, validates it, and writes the deployment record into `.deployment`. Managers must be direct EOAs; any contract manager must be listed in `auditedForwarders`. Managers and emergencyLockers must be disjoint unless `allowManagerLockerOverlap` is true (requires explicit threat-model approval). `withPunks` MUST stay true on Ethereum Mainnet: it selects the CustodialNFTVaultWithPunks variant (CryptoPunks custody); all other chains omit it and deploy the base vault.
